for
[ask1](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC27.02c), [dad1](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC16A10.05c), [dad2](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC1805.07c), [dad3](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC14C4.16), [dad4](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC3B9.22c), [dad5](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPCC417.02), [dam1](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC589.08c), [duo1](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC32F12.08c), [spc19](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPCC1223.15c), [spc34](https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPAC8C9.17c)

These are part of "attachment of spindle microtubules to kinetochore" rather than  the regulation of the process.
They already have EXP annotation to  the non-regulation terms.
